source_locator: Clark County results page, election 2013 Municipal Primary (04/02/2013), Official Election Results, contest MAYOR OF NORTH LAS VEGAS, Total row 9,153
verification_note: The county official results for the 04/02/2013 primary show Lee, John 4,909 (53.63 percent), Buck, Shari 3,248 (35.49 percent), Hunter, Mike 537 and Belger, Sharon 459, total 9,153, all 87 of 87 precincts reporting. Lee received a majority. The 06/04/2013 general lists no mayoral contest for North Las Vegas. North Las Vegas Charter section 5.020(4), as amended by chapter 218, Statutes of Nevada 2011 (AB 132), page 963, states that if one candidate receives a majority of the total votes cast for an office in the primary municipal election, that candidate must be declared elected and no general municipal election need be held for that office. Section 5.020(2) sets the primary on the Tuesday after the first Monday in April. Section 5.010 sets mayoral elections every 4 years from 1977 (2013 and 2017 in that sequence); chapter 336, Statutes of Nevada 2015 (AB 23, approved June 4, 2015) restated the sequence from 2017. Lee's majority at the primary elected him, consistent with the absence of a mayoral contest on the general ballot.
